rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single user, and only acted on that user’s account. They inspected the orders via read-only tools, identified the two tablets and their prices, and confirmed the exact item to return. The agent initially proposed refunding to the credit card but sought confirmation first; when the user asked for certainty, the agent correctly checked the payment history, explained the refund must go to the original payment method (gift card), and obtained explicit confirmation to proceed with the return to the gift card. The write action (return request) was performed only after explicit user approval and targeted the correct item and order. Final details (item, amount, refund to gift card) were accurate. Minor nit: the earlier statement about credit-card refund timing was retracted before action, and the promise of an email with instructions, while typical, wasn’t explicitly shown by tools. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
